guest.label: the partner's own logo — drop it at brands/<brand>/guests/<slug>.svg (or .png) and pass --guest <slug>

eyebrow.label: the small mono line, e.g. PARTNERSHIP or INTEGRATION LIVE

partner.label: the partner's name, as THEY write it — 20, down from 22: the title grew for mobile legibility and the frame is fixed, so the characters paid for it

support.label: one line on what the two of you now do together — never a claim on their behalf
